packaging.arrival_leak: Focal TikTok accounts reporting or contextually agreeing to arrival leak, including bare agreements, excluding brand response/retailer.
packaging.explicit_loose_top: Focal TikTok accounts explicitly describing loose or improperly screwed top.
packaging.bare_arrival_agreement: Only terse same/same way agreement with no further report.
packaging.replacement_offered: Brand offer to send service replacement.
packaging.replacement_sent: Customer explicitly reports replacement sent; not confirmed delivered.

hydration.ss_hydration_direct: Focal accounts directly reporting SS hydration; exclude a mask-serum joint result and generic hydrating interest.
hydration.ss_hydration_joint: Focal accounts reporting joint mask plus SS hydration/retention, without separable allocation.
hydration.ss_texture_direct: Focal accounts first-hand reporting SS feel/texture including comparisons and lightweight/fast-drying.
hydration.ss_texture_speculative: Focal non-user SS texture comparison or speculation.

buying.experiment_acquisition_focal: Focal accounts explicitly narrating completed Experiment acquisition/checkout/stock-up. Exclude context-only accounts, metadata alone, use alone, gifts and other brands.
buying.cart_readdition: Focal accounts explicitly returning an item to cart.
buying.stockup_focal: Focal accounts explicitly stockpiling Experiment product.
buying.routine_replacement_intended: Focal prospective product substitution in routine.
